name: Sealien Robotics Innovation R&D Center Brand Colors

brand_blue.usage: Primary brand color, header bar, key highlights

deep_blue.usage: Table headers, secondary cover panels, dark emphasis

navy_blue.usage: Primary heading text, section titles, dark contrast

light_blue.usage: Soft background tint, alternating table tint, node fill

white.usage: Slide background, text on dark surfaces

scientific_colormaps.policy: Inherit brand colors for UI/diagrams only; select perceptual/scientific colormaps (e.g. viridis, cividis, RdBu) by physical meaning for quantitative fields and experimental plots.
